items.title: Cash legs & tokenized bank money
kv: A comparison layer for stablecoins, including Bridge-issued OUSD, tokenized commercial-bank deposits, central-bank-linked settlement units and conventional payment balances.
Every tokenized asset transaction eventually meets a money claim. The name 'cash' hides major differences in issuer, redemption, access, backing and legal discharge.
Its value is the comparison itself: it forces every route to identify whose liability is moving and where final discharge or redemption actually occurs.
This is not one technology or interchangeable pool of money. Similar token interfaces can represent legally different claims.

Identify the issuer of the money claim. · Identify the legal liability and holder right. · Identify its technical representation and eligible users. · Locate orchestration, final settlement, redemption and failure remedy.
